main: Beat the summer heat with homemade Black Soybean Noodles! Skip the takeout and make this creamy, refreshing dish at home. Prep the beans once, freeze in portions, and you're just 30 seconds from a satisfying meal whenever you crave it. No need for ice, it's cool and delicious!
reply1:
Ingredients (2 servings):
• 1 cup black soybeans (seoritae)
• 500ml water (for blending)
• 2 servings whole wheat somyeon noodles
• ½ tsp salt
• 2 tbsp roasted sesame seeds
• Cucumber strips & cherry tomatoes (garnish)
reply2: Soak soybeans 6+ hours. Boil 12 min (don't overcook!). Rinse cold, then blend with 500ml water and sesame seeds for 1 min. Freeze in portions.
